name: Grave
source:
A strange young woman, who appears to have murdered all the inhabitants of a village by poisoning their well. Her Arcana is Death.
[spoiler]She originally came to the village, seeking to be converted to the faith of Mithras after her gods did not answer her prayers for her dead husband, but the villagers, seeing her as one of the enemy. gang-raped her, and thus having lost her sanity, she murdered them all. She is naked underneath her cloak and uses a poisoned scythe.[/spoiler]
